rationale: Reference class: a 2-day window of a US-Iran conflict during a ceasefire-like pause; base rate of at least one US strike on Iranian territory in a random 3-day window of such a pause is about 0.8 no-strike, so the starting point was about 0.80 YES. Evidence lowers it: reporting on Oct 30-31 describes mine and tanker attacks in Hormuz, a US official leaving open a strike this weekend, and Trump and Netanyahu threatening strikes after the Nov 3 midterms. Counter-evidence: Trump reportedly pledged no strikes before the midterms and mediation (Pakistan, Qatar, Vance) is active. Net move to 0.65; the no-ceasefire status in trackers is not what this question scores.

Reference class: large tech IPOs, where listing happens roughly 3-6 weeks after the public S-1 flip; base rate for trading within about 20 days of the public filing is roughly 0.2-0.3. Anthropic publicly filed its S-1 on Oct 26, 2026 (Nasdaq, ticker ANT), but the filing leaves price range and share count blank and no date is set. The SEC 15-day rule before roadshow puts the earliest roadshow near Nov 10, so a listing by Nov 15 is possible but tight. Reports point to a November target and possibly before Thanksgiving, which makes Nov 15 less likely than later in November. Estimate 0.20.

exposures.snippet: A prediction market listed a state of siege by October 31 at about 1% (quoted in a France 24 / news summary of the state of siege question)

rationale: Reference class: French states of siege under Article 36 are very rare; the last full state of siege in mainland France was in 1961-62 (Algeria), so the base rate over the last 60 years is about 0 per 2-week window. Current evidence: Macron ruled out a state of emergency for now on Oct 26, and Interior Minister Nunez reportedly ruled out even that; protests are ongoing, which keeps a small tail. The one market figure seen in search results was discarded and not used. Estimate 0.02.

exposures.snippet: NATO x Russia military clash by October 31 2026 market page surfaced in search results (no price text shown in the result)

rationale: Reference class: direct kinetic NATO-Russia engagements (as defined here, excluding warning shots, collisions and drones that are munitions) have been very rare since 1945, so the base rate for a 2-week window is under 0.05. Current tension is high: at least 17 attacks on frontline NATO states and Moldova in a month per a CEPA tally, Romanian jets shot down Russian drones on Oct 17, and NATO sent more Black Sea forces on Oct 20. A Russian envoy said on Oct 29 that a direct clash has not yet occurred. Many incidents are attributable only to unknown actors, and Geran munitions alone do not qualify, so I moved from about 0.05 to 0.08. A market-site link appeared despite the blocked-domain list; the result showed no price and the URL was recorded as exposure.

Reference class: AAA titles with a firm date under 3 weeks away that are delayed again late in the cycle; base rate is roughly 5-10 percent. Evidence: Take-Two and the CEO reaffirmed Nov 19 in May and later, marketing and pre-loading (Nov 12) are scheduled, and the game is listed for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The risk is that Take-Two's fiscal Q2 earnings call, usually early November and before the release date, is where the Nov 2025 delay was announced, which adds a little tail risk. Estimate 0.10.

Reference class: formal declarations of war between two or more great powers (US, Russia, China and similar) in a given 3-week window; base rate since 1945 is effectively zero per month. The current US-Iran conflict does not involve a superpower on the other side under the question's criteria, and the NATO-Russia tension is below a declared-war level. The GTA 6 date (Nov 19) bounds the window; a small amount is kept for ambiguous criteria. Estimate 0.01.

Reference class: formal US announcements ending or suspending a naval blockade, base rate across the 2026 blockade episodes (imposed Apr 13, lifted announcement June 14 after a deal, reinstated Jul 13-14) is about one qualifying announcement per roughly 2-3 months, so about 0.1 for a 2-day window before any news. Current evidence: Trump says the war will end soon without detail, Vance has contacted Iranian officials, and Tehran has not agreed to revised terms; there is no sign of an imminent deal. Strict criteria exclude partial or conditional statements. Estimate 0.08.
